triggers.filterCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var hidan = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!hidan) return false; if (!ctx.piece || ctx.piece.instanceId !== hidan.instanceId) return false; if (!ctx.damage || ctx.damage <= 0) return false; return !!(battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId !== hidan.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0 && p.statusTags && p.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'blood-oath'; }); })); }
triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var hidan = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!hidan) return { success: false }; var damage = ctx.damage; if (!damage || damage <= 0) return { success: false }; var oathed = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.ownerPlayerId !== hidan.ownerPlayerId && p.currentHp > 0 && p.statusTags && p.statusTags.some(function(t) { return t.type === 'blood-oath'; }); }); if (!oathed) { self.expire(); return { success: false }; } var result = dealDamage(hidan, oathed, damage, 'true', battle, 'blood-oath-reflect'); return { success: true, message: '血誓触发：' + oathed.name + '受到' + result.damage + '点诅咒真实伤害' }; }
